name: Temporal-uncertainty-gated regional memory residual
status: engineering gate only; no accuracy result yet
motivation: Prior global region weighting, token exclusion and pooled regional summaries did not produce meaningful Dice gains. This candidate retains native attention over every memory token and adds a zero-initialized correction assembled from predicted-mask region readouts, gated by temporal read uncertainty.

prior_implementation.paper: MatAnyone: Stable Video Matting with Consistent Memory Propagation, CVPR 2025
prior_implementation.reused_component: The official UncertPred class is loaded unchanged from matanyone/model/big_modules.py.
prior_implementation.adaptation: A small zero-initialized projection combines foreground-interior, mixed-boundary and background memory readouts; MatAnyone UncertPred gates its residual using recent stored value, current query, previous predicted mask and regional-read/recent-value difference. The residual is bounded to 0.25 times the native read's per-query RMS to limit destabilizing changes. This SAM2 adapter is project glue, not an author-provided SAM2 method.

inference.regions: Labels for each spatial memory block come from that block's own stored predicted low-resolution mask.
inference.frames: Use SAM2's native frame schedule; no good/bad-frame selection or frame dropping.
inference.memory: All native spatial keys and pointer keys remain in the original global attention. The regional branch only adds a query-grid residual after each native memory read.
inference.ground_truth: Training loss only; never used to assign inference-time regions or gate values.

required: all four attention layers observed on every read
finite nonzero gradients to every regional projection
uncertainty predictor gradient after one optimizer update
all spatial and pointer keys preserved
post-update full clip propagation completes and changes at least one prediction

training.sequences: Training sequences are the 14 non-held-out sequences in each fold.
training.sampler: Pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler adapter; prompt on first selected positive mask, then consecutive frames.
training.loss: Pinned SAM2 decoder Dice/BCE plus object-presence loss; autoregressive predicted memory is written between clip frames.

evaluation_plan.cohort: 21 promptable sequences; seq1 and seq7 excluded because they have no positive prompt mask.
evaluation_plan.design: Three fixed sequence-grouped folds, each sequence evaluated only in its held-out fold. Patient identity is unknown; this is exploratory cross-validation, not independent-patient confirmation.
evaluation_plan.training_description: See the frozen training settings above.
evaluation_plan.baseline: Paired native SAM2 using the same checkpoint, prompt frame, manifest, native frame schedule and evaluation targets.
evaluation_plan.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice across all out-of-fold predictions.
evaluation_plan.meaningful_signal_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice, positive delta on at least 14/21 sequences, and no increase in false alarms on GT-empty frames. This is a development screen, not a confirmatory claim.
evaluation_plan.interpretation: PolypGen has repeatedly informed this project. Any result is exploratory and must not be described as independent confirmation or a reliable general improvement.
